fields.completion_matrix[]: one entry per workstream: id, workstream, existing (what the repository had at HEAD 975b0db), required (the outcome the brief asks for), defects (confirmed by execution in this session), done (implementation in this session), verification (commands executed), evidence (paths relative to this folder or the repository root), status, blocker (what prevents more, if anything)
fields.status values: VERIFIED = executed in this session with evidence; VERIFIED_HISTORICAL = backed only by a dated record made before this session, not re-executed here; BLOCKED = needs data, authorization or hardware that is not available; FAILED = a check that failed and is not fixed; NOT_APPLICABLE = the requirement does not apply to this repository
fields.claims: verified_facts (executed here), historical_claims (recorded earlier, not re-executed), current_unverified_claims (true by design or expectation but not observed here), assumptions, blockers, failed_checks, not_applicable
